components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: A page title and description with optional back navigation and primary actions.

props.name: title / description
props.meaning: The page h1 and concise supporting text.

props.name: back / actions
props.meaning: Caller-owned navigation and action controls. No routing or mutation is performed by this component.

components.accessibility: Provides the page's h1. The caller supplies real links and buttons with accessible names; actions stay in reading order when the layout stacks.
components.usage: Use once below the application shell. Keep routing in the caller and provide Button controls for actions. Back navigation appears above the title.

examples.label: Settings page header
examples.description: A synthetic page heading with a local demonstration action.

components.name: SelectField
components.summary: A themed native select with an associated label, help and validation messages.

props.name: label
props.meaning: Visible accessible name associated with the select.

props.name: hint / error
props.meaning: Described-by text; error also marks the control invalid. The owning form controls announcements.

props.name: native select props
props.meaning: Includes options as children, value/defaultValue, disabled, id, handlers, ref and ARIA attributes. An omitted id is generated uniquely.

components.accessibility: Retains native select keyboard behavior and disabled options. Label and help/error IDs are associated; caller-supplied aria-describedby is retained.
components.usage: Use for a bounded choice. Supply native options and preserve server-owned option restrictions. Match TextField's label/help conventions.

examples.label: Native choice
examples.description: Synthetic options and help; the selection is not saved or sent.

components.name: Button
components.summary: A themed native button with consistent action hierarchy and pending feedback.

props.name: variant
props.meaning: Action emphasis; defaults to primary. Danger uses semantic error tokens.

props.name: loading
props.meaning: Disables interaction, exposes aria-busy and adds a decorative spinner without replacing the accessible name.

props.name: type
props.meaning: Defaults to button. Forms must explicitly use submit.

props.name: native button props
props.meaning: Forwards native handlers, disabled state, ARIA attributes, ref and children.

components.accessibility: Native keyboard semantics, visible focus and a stable accessible name. Theme text and background colors change together to retain contrast; only borders transition. Loading disables repeated activation and sets aria-busy; reduced motion stops the spinner.
components.usage: Use primary for a form's main action, secondary for alternatives, ghost for row actions and danger for consequential actions. Set loading from the actual pending operation.

examples.label: Action hierarchy
examples.description: Button variants and pending feedback; no request or account change.

components.name: TextField
components.summary: A labeled text-like input with associated help and validation messages.

props.name: label
props.meaning: Visible accessible name, associated with the native input.

props.name: hint / error
props.meaning: Described-by text; error also marks the input invalid. The owning form controls error announcements.

props.name: native input props
props.meaning: Includes type, value/defaultValue, autocomplete, required, id, handlers, ref and ARIA attributes. An omitted id is generated uniquely.

components.accessibility: Label and help/error IDs remain associated across renders. Caller-supplied aria-describedby is retained. Uses native input and validation semantics.
components.usage: Use for text-like inputs, including password and one-time codes. Supply appropriate autocomplete and validation attributes. Keep credentials in temporary form state only.

examples.label: Labels, help and errors
examples.description: Synthetic profile fields with no persistence or network request.
examples.code: <TextField label="Nome" hint="Como você aparece no IA-MNS." required />

components.name: SectionCard
components.summary: A named section with a consistent heading, optional description and decorative icon.

props.name: title
props.meaning: Level-two heading and accessible section name.

props.name: description / icon
props.meaning: Supporting text and an aria-hidden decorative icon.

props.name: native section props
props.meaning: Includes children, className and native section attributes. The heading owns aria-labelledby.

components.accessibility: Uses a semantic section named by a unique h2. Icons are decorative; the title must communicate meaning without them.
components.usage: Group related settings below a page's h1. Parent layouts own grid placement; the card adapts to its available width.

examples.label: Settings section
examples.description: A synthetic settings group demonstrating the shared surface and controls.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.summary: A compact textual label for a state or category.

props.name: children
props.meaning: Visible text communicating the state or category.

props.name: tone
props.meaning: Defaults to neutral; accent emphasizes an enabled or current state without implying a global severity.

components.accessibility: Meaning is conveyed by visible text, never color alone. This is static text, not a live region or an interactive control.
components.usage: Use short text for enabled settings, current sessions and permission categories. Announce dynamic outcomes separately in the owning workflow.

components.name: ErrorNotice
components.summary: Displays a public API failure message and an optional reload action.

props.name: error
props.meaning: Mapped through the shared public failure-message boundary.

props.name: operation
props.meaning: Selects the failure wording; failed or lost writes are reported as unknown outcomes. Defaults to read.

props.name: messages
props.meaning: Module-specific wording for its own stable error codes.

props.name: onReload
props.meaning: Optional recovery action when current data can be refreshed.

props.name: reloadLabel
props.meaning: Accessible name of the reload action; defaults to Reload.

components.accessibility: Uses role=alert so the failure is announced; the optional reload control is a native button.
components.usage: Pass the original error to preserve stable-code mapping. Offer reload only when the current data can be refreshed, and never imply that an unknown write outcome failed.

examples.label: Unavailable service with reload
examples.description: A synthetic SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE response; no live request is involved.
